title: Glaise (Yellow Harvest) - Location, Weakness & Rewards
description: Glaise in Expedition 33's Yellow Harvest: exact route to the Yellow Spire Wrecks, its Fire/Ice weakness, and the Plenum weapon it drops.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content:
Glaise is an optional boss found in the Yellow Harvest side area, specifically at the Yellow Spire Wrecks. A second Glaise appears later in The Chosen Path.

The Yellow Harvest is a side area you can enter once you complete the main story events in Esquie's Nest and unlock Esquie as a mount for exploring The Continent.

sections.title: How to Reach Glaise
sections.content:
After entering the Yellow Harvest portal, climb the handholds on the wall to the right of the Entrance Rest Point Flag (Expedition 68), then follow the northwestern path briefly into a tunnel before emerging outside.

You will get a short cutscene on arrival - it triggers near the grotto outside the cave, where the boss spawns.

sections.title: Weakness & Resistances
sections.content:
PropertyValue
Weak toFire, Ice
ResistsLightning
AbsorbsEarth

Bring Fire and/or Ice. Crucially, it absorbs Earth - Earth damage will heal it rather than hurt it, so check your weapon damage types before the fight.

sections.title: Rewards
sections.content:
• Plenum weapon (Level 7, for Maelle)
  • Energising Attack I Pictos (Level 7)
  • Polished Chroma Catalyst x3
  • 24,190 EXP

sections.title: Strategy
sections.content:
Glaise has a clean weakness pair and a single absorbed element, which makes it more of a build check than an execution test.

  • Maelle and Lune are the natural picks - they specialise into Fire and Ice respectively
  • Never bring Earth damage. It is absorbed, so an Earth weapon turns the fight into an unwinnable slog
  • Because Lightning is only resisted (not absorbed), it is inefficient but not actively harmful
